methodology: Frozen V5 cross-venue derivatives evidence with 15-minute lagged Binance USD-M positioning context against Bybit 15m returns. Three disjoint 90-day windows (2023-11-30, 2024-08-31, 2024-11-30), BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, four-fold stability screen, 15 bps round-trip cost adjustment.

final_replicated.interpretation: A stronger 1h increase in global long/short positioning consistently predicts weaker subsequent 3h returns; a contrarian crowd-positioning effect.
The contrarian crowd-positioning effect persists at the 6h horizon.
The same effect remains detectable at the 12h horizon.

rejected_after_third_window.reason: Passed the first two-window cross-symbol gate but did not re-qualify on the untouched 2023 BTC/ETH window.

next_gate: Build a preregistered deterministic V5.1 signal from global_long_short_change_1h only, calibrate thresholds on discovery data only, and test on a fourth untouched window before any paper-trading activation.
